static_traits.name: Dong Na
static_traits.social_status: Having friends and colleagues to communicate with, but not yet discussing resignation with anyone
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not previously received psychotherapy; no similar problems occurred in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, relatively good logic, tends toward overthinking and negative focus; emotionally tense but able to self-reflect; good cooperation, cautious tone

basic_info.main_problem: After being insulted by a student last week, I am considering quitting teaching; this makes me doubt whether teaching is still right for me.
basic_info.core_demands: That event made me realize I need professional support to deal with my emotions and make informed decisions about my career.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough,能力not足

special_situations.event: Last week in class, a student swore at Dong Na in public and insulted her
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If students publicly disrespect me, it means I have no authority and am not suited to be a teacher
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Considers resigning to avoid further failure and humiliation; focuses attention on negative events
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Maybe I am not suited for this job; I have no authority

special_situations.event: Each situation before work or when interacting with students
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot perfectly control the classroom, it equals losing authority and worse things will happen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated worrying and over-rehearsing before work in hopes of avoiding mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: All the students will think I am weak; the class may get out of control

special_situations.event: When recalling past positive feedback from parents and colleagues
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once a serious negative event occurs, past achievements and recognition no longer count
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Filtering out positive information, repeatedly replaying negative events
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Those good reviews do not matter; everything has changed now

special_situations.event: Has support from friends and colleagues yet keeps putting off discussing resignation with anyone
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my difficulties, others will look down on me and think I am incompetent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids seeking help from and sharing with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Colleagues will think I am incompetent; students all see me as weak

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be respected and seen as a competent teacher, maintaining a sense of control in the classroom
core_conflict.fear: Fears losing control, being belittled or negated, worrying others will regard them as weak
defense_goal: Maintains safety and self-esteem through avoidance (not discussing with others) and considering resignation
Demanding high standards of oneself to prevent another mistake

object_relations.self_representation: A powerless, anxious teacher who loses authority through being disrespected
object_relations.object_representation: Students/others are contemptuous judges who may negate me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about the student insult incident or worrying about colleagues' and students' views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Dong Na subconsciously regards others' reactions as a negation of her own ability, believing others will see her as weak (transference: projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tense and restrained tone, uses speculative expressions (such as 'they will...' and 'everyone thinks...'), avoids going deeply into the evidence, and shifts to others' opinions.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When encouraged to share difficulties with colleagues or friends and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes exposing vulnerability will bring evaluation and humiliation, feels unsafe, and turns to self-blame
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses self-blaming language (such as 'it is all my problem' and 'I am not good enough'), reduces emotional expression, and avoids seeking external support.

manifestations: After being verbally abused by a student, begins to doubt whether teaching still suits them
Negative focusing makes past positive feedback seem distant and lose its sense of meaning
Faces the choice of whether to resign, hoping to make an informed decision but has long delayed discussing it with others
outcomes: Procrastination and avoidance of seeking help

manifestations: Living alone and not having discussed resignation or emotional troubles with others
The experience of lacking on-the-spot support in important decisions

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Using the self-demand 'I should/must be able to perfectly control the classroom'
Viewing one mistake as a total failure

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Worrying that all students think one is weak
Speculating that colleagues would look down on oneself and not daring to ask for help

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects and instead does it to themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: 有支持系统却not主动求助
Turning pressure and criticism toward oneself, self-reproach

positive_force: Many years of teaching experience, having received positive feedback from parents and colleagues in the past
Having some social support resources (friends and colleagues to communicate with)
Willing to seek professional help, having motivation for self-reflection and adjustment
Able to propose more balanced alternative thoughts (such as 'one bad day does not erase my achievements')
negative_force: A cognitive pattern of negative filtering and overgeneralization
High self-expectations and self-reproach, black-and-white standards
Catastrophizing worry and anticipation about losing control and being judged
Sleep problems and persistent anxiety affect functioning

target_behavior.behavior: Before work and when interacting with students, marked anxiety and physiological tension appear (such as 'a knot in the stomach'), accompanied by sleep difficulties
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophizes and overgeneralizes an incident of being insulted, worrying about loss of authority and worse outcomes occurring
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential loss of control and others' negative evaluation, seeking short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance declines, interpersonal relationships are strained, and sleep quality is poor

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding seeking others' support and discussing thoughts of resigning
antecedent: When thinking about needing to discuss with colleagues or friends
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being seen as weak or incompetent, mind reading presuming others' negative evaluation
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated or humiliated to keep the surface integrity of self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Support resources are not used; anxiety is maintained and decisions are difficult

target_behavior.behavior: An avoidance tendency of developing and repeatedly considering resignation
antecedent: When feeling the class may get out of control
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralization and catastrophizing inference, equating a single event with career unsuitability
target_behavior.function: Avoids encountering disrespect or loss-of-control situations again by withdrawing
target_behavior.consequence: Career development is threatened, further reinforcing negative self-evaluation and anxiety
